title: Young Boy in Overcoat and Cap, 1950s Yard B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-20th-century black and white snapshot featuring a young boy dressed neatly in a double-breasted overcoat, a flat newsboy cap, tall folded socks, and saddle-style dress shoes. He stands on a residential lawn bordered by neatly trimmed spherical bushes and a concrete walkway, capturing classic suburban childhood attire and suburban life from the 1950s era.
